title: Shot feedback component in C++: recoil, muzzle flash, tracer, impact flash, haptics, placeholder sound (for T-0015)
acceptance: Every shot drives barrel/mount recoil, muzzle discharge, a cosmetic tracer from muzzle to end, an impact flash on hits, a haptic pulse on that hand and a report sound
Haptic strength (0 = off) and reduced flash respected
description: Split from T-0015, whose paths cover only content. Placeholder geometry and engine materials/sounds until art and audio exist (T-0034, T-0036).

result.summary: UCannonFeedbackComponent (Source/ETM/Weapons/Feedback), one per cannon on AXRSeatedRigPawn (LeftFeedback/RightFeedback). Per shot: recoil kick (6 cm back, 2.5 deg up, settles in 0.15 s) on its own pivot with a placeholder barrel; amber-white directional muzzle flash (0.05 s); a tracer from a pool of 3 that races muzzle to end in 0.04 s and is gone by 0.08 s; an impact flash from a pool of 3 on hits and frame blocks, plus OnImpact(location, weak point, blocked) for debris VFX; a 0.06 s haptic pulse on that hand; a report sound. Overheat lock gives a 0.25 s full buzz. HapticStrength 0..1 (0 = off) and bReducedFlash (smaller, shorter flashes; tracer kept) for the T-0037 settings. Ticks only while animating; everything built at BeginPlay, nothing per shot. Placeholders: engine cylinder/cone, EmissiveMeshMaterial tinted amber, 1kSineTonePing pitched to 0.3.
result.verification: Built on UE 5.8.4, zero errors and warnings; all 55 ETM tests pass, 4 new (ETM.Weapons.Feedback.*): all seven parts fire on a real cannon shot and settle within 0.2 s; tracer starts at the muzzle and reaches the impact at half its life; haptics off/half; reduced flash; overheat buzz; 2 minutes of burst fire (200+ shots) creates no new visuals and never overflows the pools; on the real rig pawn, camera, XR origin and pawn never move while firing, and only the firing hand gets haptics. Not seen rendered, not heard, not felt: no headset; the test run uses no audio device.
result.remaining: Everything is placeholder: final muzzle/tracer/impact art and Niagara debris (T-0034), real report and servo sounds (T-0036). The engine tone is a beep pitched down, not a report. The emissive material's colour parameter name ('Color') was read from the asset, not confirmed rendered. Effect cost on Quest 2/3 is unmeasured (T-0015 device check). Branch agent/claude-code-dartonx-pc/t-0048 needs a PR.
result.next: Review T-0048. T-0015 stays open for the on-device budget check.
